Totals: 267 pass, 144 refused as expected, 32 fail. 31 failures are V2 expectation or design errors (amm was correct) and 1 is an app/ bug; no failure is an amm bug. Every failed row stays in the matrix with its cause.\par
The 31 V2 errors: 26 rows were replaced by an addendum (S16, S17) whose expectations were written before it ran; its 30 rows all met their expectation (17 pass, 13 refused as expected). 1 row (\texttt{combo\_export}) had a wrong JSON path; the corrected predicate holds on the same report.json (\texttt{posthoc\_checks.json}, checked post hoc). 4 rows (\texttt{fam\_all\_bounds}) had a wrong \texttt{n\_cells} expectation while the verdict predicate held; they were not re-run.\par
The app/ failure (\texttt{gui\_health}: /api/health showed the mock schema and code hash in live mode) was fixed after V2 ("Post-V2 fixes" in the V2 NOTES): /api/health now reports \texttt{amm.tools.SCHEMA\_VERSION} and \texttt{amm.tools.code\_hash()} in live mode (mock mode keeps the mirror's amm-tools/2). The matrix row stays \texttt{fail} as recorded.\par
Before run 1, a probe on the library found three amm bugs (\texttt{negative\_G\_min}, \texttt{zener\_target} and \texttt{hz\_partial\_check}); they were fixed before any matrix row ran (results/software/NOTES\_V2\_fixes.md).\par
Replay: 170 of 170 V2 session logs replay exactly; the static PA12 certificate is identical through MCP, GUI, CLI and tutorial 02 (result hash d47062dbaab89457). Test suite after V2: 174 passed, 1 skipped (the skip passed when rerun alone).\par
Interfaces: lib = Python library (\texttt{amm.tools.Session}); mcp = MCP server driven by a client with no LLM; gui = live GUI HTTP API; gui-edge = clicks in headless Edge; cli = \texttt{python -m amm.cli} (added in V2).\par
